tasks.query: REPLICATE [extractparts] ([year] VARCHAR(10), [month] VARCHAR(20), [date] VARCHAR(10), [hour] VARCHAR(10), [minute] VARCHAR(20), [second] VARCHAR(20)) SELECT [Id], [DateTimeCol], YEAR([DateTimeCol]) AS [year], MONTH([DateTimeCol]) AS [month], DAY([DateTimeCol]) AS [date], HOUR([DateTimeCol]) AS [hour], MINUTE([DateTimeCol]) AS [minute], SECOND([DateTimeCol]) AS [second] FROM [dbo].[extractparts]
